protocol.budget_protocol: Each of 60, 120 and 240 gpu_s caps one complete fixed-work ensemble per arm, per timing pair. Repeat identical work at each budget; do not convert budget into more steps or replicas. Apply same scientific margins at every budget; report budget-specific decisions without selecting a favorable budget. Performance and metric confidence statements are per method and budget; no simultaneous coverage across methods/budgets claimed.

confidence_rule.decision: Use exact binomial order-statistic bounds. Performance: one-sided 95% lower confidence bound on median paired baseline_gpu_s/method_gpu_s must exceed 1.05. With 15 timing pairs, fourth ordered speedup is valid (Binomial(15,0.5) lower tail through 3 is 0.017578125). Equivalence: two-sided family confidence 95%, Bonferroni across two metrics, per-tail alpha 0.0125. With eight seeds use min/max paired differences (each tail probability 0.00390625). Both confidence intervals must lie strictly inside their sealed +/- absolute margins. Require all fixed work, valid outputs and both performance and equivalence gates; missing outputs, censored runs or failure of either gate cannot pass. No significance test of zero difference substitutes for equivalence.

equal_outcome_target.reason: Fixed-work molecular dynamics benchmark has no calibrated monotone outcome curve or threshold-to-quality target. Scientific target is unchanged DHFR physics, eight specified seeds and 25000 steps per replica with paired median final/mean potential energies equivalent within baseline-derived Monte Carlo standard-error margins.

infeasible_methods.reason: Only one GPU available. Equal-GPU-second Amdahl/k bound is 1.0, below 1.05.
Transfer wall fraction 0.0035348589481805615 with k=2 gives Amdahl bound 1.0017705588119201, below 1.05; launch and merge overhead further limit benefit.

paired_seed_tests.description: Pair method and baseline final and mean potential energy by identical input and seed. Langevin integration and random initial velocities make outputs stochastic despite fixed seeds and DeterministicForces=true. For each metric form eight method-minus-baseline differences; test paired population median against sealed positive absolute margins. Use first measured timing pair for scientific comparison; other timing repetitions are diagnostic, not additional independent seeds. Preserve all eight per-replica records; median equivalence does not establish trajectory identity.

predicted_outcome.reason: Fixed-work benchmark: eight replicas of 25000 steps each; no calibrated scientific outcome-versus-gpu_s curve. Budget is an enclosing execution cap, not permission to change work or seeds.

uncertainty.basis: Prospective assumption: distribute the fixed eight seed-replicas over four workers in two waves on one GPU under MPS. Profile measured two-way factor 1.5121544029020553 and four-way factor 1.9392289002857779; neither is this method implementation gain. Kernel fraction 0.5605201780438667 and CUDA API host fraction 0.4359449630079529 suggest concurrency headroom. Interval discounts worker launch, repeated context initialization, H2D/D2H transfers, synchronization and ordered result merge, plus wave imbalance.

power.assumption: For each independent seed, joint probability that BOTH paired metric differences fall strictly inside their respective margins is at least 0.99 under the scientifically equivalent alternative. Then all eight seed differences inside implies both min/max confidence intervals inside, with probability at least 0.99^8. This is a prospective design assumption; paired method variance is unavailable, so unconditional achieved power cannot be claimed. Eight seeds are fixed by intake; do not add post-hoc seeds or widen margins.
power.finite_bounds: With eight independent continuous paired differences, min/max interval coverage is 1 - 2*(0.5^8) = 0.9921875 per metric, exceeding Bonferroni-required 0.975 for two metrics at family confidence 0.95.

protocol.scheduling_protocol: For each method and budget, run 15 adjacent baseline/method pairs. Seeded pseudorandom fair coin selects arm order independently per pair; serialize arms on same GPU and reset arm-specific workers/MPS state between arms. Fix method order to prediction-array order and budgets ascending. No unrelated GPU jobs; retain all pairs without outcome-based exclusions.

splits.calibration: Existing baseline seed ensemble 1000..1007 and supplied profile only; used to seal margins and prospective intervals.
splits.evaluation: Same fixed input and seeds in fresh paired baseline/method executions after sealing; no independent held-out coordinate system or held-out seed set. This is a prospective implementation comparison conditional on this benchmark, not evidence of generalization.
splits.no_adaptation: No tuning on evaluation outputs, stopping based on significance, changing margins or selecting seeds. Any scope/tolerance change requires new sealed run.

timing_scope.description: Adapter measures enclosing elapsed process wall from launch through successful output collection for all eight replicas. Include process/MPS startup attributable to arm, imports, input parsing, System and context construction, compilation/initialization, velocity generation, integration, synchronized energy queries, transfers, worker dispatch, merge, JSON writing and teardown. Synchronize device via adapter before stopping; concurrent wall is enclosing completion time, never sum of worker times. Same scope for both arms. Profile and baseline reported wall scopes are narrower, so forecasts include unmeasured launch/transfer/merge overhead discounts.

protocol.warmup_protocol: Before measured pairs at each budget, complete one full fixed-work execution per arm, excluded from timing statistics and scientific seed count. Fresh worker/context creation remains inside every measured process interval; no context state reused. Use same input and fixed seeds in warmup; terminate warmup before measured runs.
